warn.iai_fq_resistance: Warning: local E. coli fluoroquinolone resistance is 10% or more; a candidate of another class was moved ahead
iai.sepsis: Sepsis or septic shock: urgent source control and broad treatment; specialist review.
iai.mrsa: MRSA colonisation or history: an agent active against MRSA is added.
iai.sis2010.healthcare_esbl: Healthcare-associated with ESBL risk: a carbapenem or piperacillin-tazobactam.
iai.sis2010.healthcare_ent: Healthcare-associated with enterococcal risk: a regimen active against enterococci.
iai.sis2010.healthcare: Healthcare-associated: broad Gram-negative and anaerobic cover guided by local data.
iai.sis2010.community_high: High severity or risk: an antipseudomonal regimen with enterococcal cover; quinolones only with high local susceptibility.
iai.sis2010.community_mild: Mild to moderate community-acquired: a narrower single agent or a cephalosporin plus metronidazole; 4-7 days after source control.
iai.sis2010.source_control: Without source control the course follows the clinical response; surgical review.
iai.sis2017.enterococcus: Enterococcal risk: a regimen active against enterococci.
iai.sis2017.healthcare: Healthcare-associated: a broad single agent or combination.
iai.sis2017.community_high: High-risk community-acquired: a broad regimen; no aminoglycoside or quinolone is added to a beta-lactam.
iai.sis2017.community_low: Lower-risk community-acquired: ceftriaxone or cefotaxime plus metronidazole, or ertapenem; quinolones in serious beta-lactam allergy.
iai.sis2017.source_control: Without definitive source control 5-7 days, then reassess.
iai.ekmud.healthcare: Healthcare-associated: a broad choice guided by local resistance data.
iai.ekmud.community_high: Severe community-acquired: an antipseudomonal regimen; quinolones are not first choice.
iai.ekmud.community_mild_esbl: Local ESBL rate of 10% or more, or an ESBL history: a single agent active against ESBL producers.
iai.ekmud.community_mild: Mild to moderate community-acquired: a single agent or a cephalosporin plus metronidazole; quinolones come later because E. coli susceptibility in Turkey is low.
iai.ekmud.source_control: Without source control, surgical review and clinical follow-up.
